lines: ATTENTION: will the owner of a blue hatchback please move it. It's blocking the fryer.
Reminder: the vending machine is NOT a chicken. Stop sorting it.
Night shift karaoke is cancelled. Again. You know who you are.
Whoever keeps clucking on the intercom: we can hear you.
Lost: one hard hat, chicken-sized. Answers to Gerald.
The fire drill is at 4 AM. It is not a real fire. Probably.
Today's safety tip: the belt does not stop for snacks.

note.text: Welcome to nights. Wings LEFT, drumsticks RIGHT, nuggets STRAIGHT on. Don't make me come down there.
Nuggets now go RIGHT. Same box as the drumsticks. Don't ask.
Red-stamped trays go STRAIGHT to the bin. Doesn't matter what's on them.
Tenders are on tonight. Tenders go LEFT.
Maintenance swapped the chutes. Everything that went LEFT goes RIGHT, and RIGHT goes LEFT.
Blue stamp means VIP order. Blue goes LEFT, whatever's on it.
Wing shortage upstairs. Wings go STRAIGHT now.
Red stamps were a printer error. Red trays go wherever their chicken goes.
